verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SolidJS is developed in a public GitHub repository (github.com/solidjs/solid), and a community member cites its visible commit history, so the source appears readable. No evidence item states the license terms, so the open-license part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit open-license documentation (e.g. MIT/LICENSE file), first-party statement on source availability and licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Its small commit history (about 1,823 commits, mostly the creator's) gives confidence for long-term maintenance
